# Good workflows {background-color="#23373B" .center .middle}

## What is a good workflow

??What a good AI-assisted workflow looks like, framed for people who can't read the code the AI writes??

## When you can't read the code

??How to check work you can't read line by line: ask for explanations, check outputs against known answers, test on small examples??

## Environments and resources

??Which Python / R is being used, software environments, not using compute or data resources it shouldn't??

## Good practice still applies

Good coding practice is still essential when an AI writes the code:

- Clear, specific instructions
- Working on small subsets of data before the full dataset
- ??Keeping a record of what was asked and done (messages, version control)??

# Hard lines {background-color="#23373B" .center .middle}

## CLAUDE.md and other configuration files

??What CLAUDE.md and similar instruction files are, and how to write them: be specific, set the tone you want??

## Why rules loosen over time

??Why instructions can weaken over a long session (context compression), and how to guard against it??
